designationHistory.indexText: Officially established on January 4, 1994, to protect and restore bottomland hardwood forest along the Trinity River in southeast Texas.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Trinity River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, Mar. 28, 2012 (2012-7400): Trinity River NWR "was officially established on January 4, 1994"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Trinity River National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1994 to protect what was once a much larger, frequently flooded, bottomland hardwood forest ecosystem along the Trinity River.
